_doc: The released mask models (rpp.mask.hub). 0.99.0, the rename MPPP -> RPP: the models are rpp_mask_v1..v4; their names before 0.99 (mppp_mask_v*) are 'aliases', so a block's configuration that names mppp_mask_v3 is the same configuration. 'file' is the cache and Hugging Face name; 'old_files' are the same bytes under the names before 0.99 (a cached old file is used as it is, nothing is downloaded again). The URLs are tried in order: ctate7163/rpp-mask (the renamed repository), then ctate7163/mppp-mask (forwarded by Hugging Face after the rename), then the GitHub release.

rpp_mask_v1.description: ConvNeXt-tiny + FPN/ASPP with a stride-4 decoder; include (terrain and sky) vs exclude (rover hardware, rover shadows and other artificial objects: robotic arm, drill bits, Ingenuity, bellypan, sample tubes, FOD); trained on the v7 mask set of Mars 2020 engineering-camera and Mastcam-Z frames (24 Sep 2026, val IoU 0.971)

rpp_mask_v2.description: ConvNeXt-tiny + FPN/ASPP with a stride-4 decoder; include (terrain and sky) vs exclude (rover hardware, rover shadows and other artificial objects: robotic arm, drill bits, Ingenuity, bellypan, sample tubes, FOD); trained on the v7 mask set of Mars 2020 engineering-camera and Mastcam-Z frames (25 Sep 2026, 4 epochs, val IoU 0.977)

rpp_mask_v3.description: ConvNeXt-tiny + FPN/ASPP with a stride-4 decoder; include (terrain and sky) vs exclude (rover hardware, rover shadows and other artificial objects: robotic arm, drill bits, Ingenuity, bellypan, sample tubes, FOD); trained on the v7 mask set of Mars 2020 engineering-camera and Mastcam-Z frames (26 Sep 2026, 9 of 10 epochs, val IoU 0.979)

rpp_mask_v4.description: ConvNeXt-tiny + FPN/ASPP with a stride-4 decoder; include (terrain and sky) vs exclude (rover hardware, rover shadows and other artificial objects); trained on the v8 mask set (4,095 hand-edited masks, sols 9-2022: Navcam, Front/Rear Hazcam, Mastcam-Z, SHERLOC WATSON), images of the standard MPPP pipeline only, horizontal flips and a zoom-crop of large Navcam/Hazcam frames (30 Oct 2026, best of 20 epochs at 13, held-out IoU 0.978)
rpp_mask_v4.note: not on Hugging Face yet (16 Nov 2026: 404 Entry not found): python -m rpp_studies.mask_training.release_mask_model upload rpp_mask_v4

rpp_mask_v5.description: ConvNeXt-tiny + FPN/ASPP with a stride-4 decoder; include (terrain and sky) vs exclude (rover hardware, rover shadows and other artificial objects); v5.2, second run (18 Nov 2026; Christian, 19 Nov: 'v5p2_2 is perfect'): fine-tuned from v5.1 (itself from v3) at lr 1e-5 on the v8 mask set with 198 Curiosity (MSL) Navcam and front Hazcam frames (4,965 training frames), mild photometric augmentation on half the samples, gray 0.1, a 2 px edge-ignore band; the weights of its first epoch; held-out IoU 0.978 (the frozen test list); on 90 hand-cleaned frames no model trained on (validation_set_v1) exclusion IoU 0.974 against v3's 0.973 (+0.0017, 95 % interval -0.0063 to +0.0091: no difference overall) - Curiosity Navcam 0.983 against 0.971, Curiosity front Hazcam 0.968 against 0.934
rpp_mask_v5.note: 0.99.34: SHA-256 and size written by the export (python -m rpp.mask.hub export ... --name rpp_mask_v5 --update-registry); upload with upload_mask_models.bat. Not the registry default (rpp_mask_v3); freeze 3 runs on this checkpoint.
